bio.text: Curtis Travis, a Democrat, has represented District 72 in the Alabama House of Representatives since taking office on November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Travis was born in Sawyerville, graduated from Akron High School in Hale County, and earned a bachelor's degree in petroleum engineering from the University of Alabama.
His career experience includes working as a builder, a manager and an assistant pastor.
